newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends steady at 14.88 rgt a kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends steady at 14.88 rgt a kg.

text.p: Tin price ended steady at Thursday's 14.88 ringgit after both buyers and sellers decided to close deals at the opening level.
Traders said the market was quiet with volume falling to 74 tonnes from 126 on Thursday. Buying was from Europe and Malaysia.
The local price is now at par with London, after holding a $30 a tonne premium previously.
Traders expect the market to consolidate at around current level and could rise back to 15.00 ringgit if demand continues active. --Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911) ($1=2.5090 ringgit)
